title: 아직 여기
instrumental_control: No separate instrumental toggle observed in current Advanced UI; exact [Instrumental] lyrics tag and No vocals style used
style: Instrumental melodic electronica, 125 BPM, 4/4, Eb major, around six minutes. An original memorable synth hook is simple, fragile and sorrowful; punchy big-beat drums make it exhilarating. Begin with a thin chip-like digital motif and sparse accompaniment. Deepen its tone with firm bass, rounded harmony and a strong kick-snare drive. Transform the SAME new hook through changing timbres, harmonies and rhythmic settings, without burying it in new melodies. Short rising guitar-like riffs and stop-start gaps propel it forward. Pull back into an uneasy low-bass bridge, then return with stacked instrumental harmonies and a wider register. Alternate accumulation, subtraction and forceful re-entry; save the fullest texture for the final hook. Keep the melody wistful at peak energy. Bittersweet major-to-minor colors, clear upper melody, weighty drums, polished studio sound. No vocals.
exclude: crowd cheers/claps/chants/room bleed, vocals, novelty chiptune/arcade sound effects, busy intro/full drums from the start, generic festival EDM drops, aggressive supersaw/dubstep growls, excessive reverb/ambient wash, constant maximum intensity
